question: Under what temporal condition are old age and death said to be destroyed?
premises: That practice is carried out for one year.
When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
inference: When the practice has been carried out for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
uncertainties: The specific practice referred to is presupposed from the preceding context.
plain_english: When practiced for one year, old age and death are destroyed.
